title: Formal Review Requests on Decided Late-Filing Reconsiderations of TRICARE Select Lines (Appeals and Grievances)
content:
**Appeals and Grievances — formal review of a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration on a late-filed TRICARE Select line: request card**

**Rule.** When the appellant asks for a formal review of a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration on a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing, the amount in dispute booked on the case is the amount carried to the next level, figured afresh on the day the next level is asked for.

**Prerequisite.** Where a claim has more than one posting still standing with the same denial, the amount carried to the next level is fixed only after the claim's highest-numbered such posting stands joined to a Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on an earlier posting of the claim.

**Points of reading.** "Figured afresh" means the amount booked with the request is figured on the day of the request from the records as they then stand; it is booked on the decided case itself. The formal review is decided by the Defense Health Agency appeals division.

## Invocation: `request_formal_review_d6793db3`

**What it does.** The appellant asks, in their own name, for a formal review of a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration. One call moves that case to status escalated, records today as the date the next-level request was received and books the amount in dispute given as the amount carried to the next level; the case file is then forwarded to the Defense Health Agency appeals division. The appellant can see the escalated status and the request date on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-run tool: the agent unlocks `request_formal_review_d6793db3` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `appeal_case_id` | the reference number of the decided reconsideration case, as returned by the appeal case lookup | identifier |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute carried to the next level, in USD | 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** "Formal review requested for case [case id]: status escalated, request received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." — the date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. A status of escalated indicates that the request was recorded.
